description: Britain, France and Canada said Tuesday they will ban imports from Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank, with a UK minister accusing Israel of turning a blind eye to the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians there. The moves prompted a furious Israel to unveil immediate counter-measures targeting Britain, as Jerusalem-based journalist Jordana Miller reports.

title: FRANCE 24 report reveals Russia’s war on Ukraine’s books and cultural identity
description: In Ukraine, the war is not being fought solely on the battlefield. This summer, Russian strikes severely affected the publishing industry, destroying dozens of warehouses and logistics centres. Millions of books and textbooks have been lost. For many Ukrainians, these attacks are part of an effort to erase their linguistic and cultural identity, as FRANCE 24’s Yegor Terletzkyi and Emmanuelle Chaze report.

title: Rungis market chief on supply chains and feeding the world
description: In today’s edition, FRANCE 24’s Delano D'Souza speaks with the man at the heart of France's food supply chain. title: The world's third global aerospace market: India's civil aviation sector takes off
description: The aviation sector is one of the India's strongest-performing industries. More than 70 airports have been built over the past decade, and the country counts over 400 million air passengers annually. In just ten years, India has become the world's third-largest aviation market, behind China and the United States.

title: Iran attacks US base after American strikes on tankers
description: Iran said it fired ballistic missiles at a US base in Jordan early Wednesday, in retaliation for US strikes on Iranian oil tankers in the Gulf of Oman and near Kharg Island, off Iran’s coast. The US said five Iranian tankers were destroyed.

title: 'New escalation in Yemen deeply concerning everyone in the region'
description: Oliver Farry is pleased to welcome Jules Grange Gastinel, Researcher at the Institute for Research and Studies on the Arab and Muslim World (IREMAM). He depicts Yemen as moving from a prolonged condition of unresolved conflict into renewed regional confrontation. The relative calm established after 2022, he argues, never amounted to a durable political settlement: Yemen remains divided between rival political, financial and military institutions.

title: The Times: 'Counterproductive' sanctions on Israel don't match the 'theatrical rhetoric'
description: PRESS REVIEW – Wednesday, September 9: British papers are reacting to the sanctions imposed on Israel. Next: Israeli papers discuss Haaretz's October 7 revelatory investigation. Also: CDs are back! Finally, South Park renames itself to South America to mock Trump.

title: Video: Dozens protest potential Strait of Hormuz deployment
description: Almost 100 anti-war activists protested on Wednesday outside the Sejong Centre in Seoul.

title: How the UK’s ban on Israeli settlement goods has holes
description: Over a year, the UK imported just £6m ($8.1m) in goods recorded as Palestinian, including Israeli settlement goods.

title: Video: RSF drone attack on Sudan court kills at least 13 people
description: An RSF drone attack on a court in Sudan’s North Kordofan state has killed at least 13 people and wounded more than 20.

title: How has Israel hit back against sanctions by the UK, others?
description: Israel announced four countermeasures including the closure of the British consulate in East Jerusalem.

title: Photos: Large Oslo crowd bids farewell to Norway’s King Harald V
description: Thousands line streets of Norways capital as King Harald V is laid to rest during service attended by world leaders.

title: Nigeria, Boko Haram reportedly reach secret three-month ceasefire
description: The reported truce follows the release of 360 villagers abducted during a Boko Haram attack in northeastern Nigeria.

title: Brent crude surpasses $100 a barrel as Iran, US escalate attacks
description: Benchmark Brent crude hits $100, shaking markets and fuelling concerns over rising inflation pressures worldwide.
